excerpt.en:
Mass sensors monitoring [from.solar_system.GetName] are showing erratic readings in the aftermath of the [from.GetAffectedStormType].

System diagnostics show no sign of a technical error with the equipment. These readings require further investigation.

texts.zh:
[from.solar_system.GetName]星系内的异常读数源自一片由[from.GetAffectedStormType]的余波所残留下的不寻常的碎片阵列。

这个漂浮的实体是由一团无定形的宇宙污泥在风暴的极端压力下锻造而成。它的无数组成元素形成了一种独特的活性化合物。

对其化学成分的深度研究可以对产生它的条件提供有价值的星际气象学洞见。
texts.en:
The erratic sensor readings in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system are derived from an exceptional debris formation left in the wake of the [from.GetAffectedStormType].

This drifting entity is an amorphous blob of cosmic sludge, forged in the extreme pressures of the storm. Its innumerable constituent elements have formed a uniquely reactive compound.

Focused study of its chemistry could yield valuable astrometeorological insights into the conditions that produced it.
